bukti: This work investigated the application of hyperspectral imaging and ANN models with the k-fold cross-validation method for ripeness prediction of oil palm fresh fruit bunches (FFB)
Image acquisition was performed on each oil palm FFB moving on a conveyor.
Table 4 shows that the average accuracy for all seven folds is 79.17%.
catatan: Klasifikasi dua kelas (mentah/matang) dari spektrum rerata citra hiperspektral 400-1000 nm pada konveyor di dalam kotak gelap. Tiap tandan dipindai dari tiga sisi (184 tandan, 523 titik data), tetapi tiap sisi diperlakukan sebagai titik data terpisah tanpa penggabungan antarsisi; multipandang Y hanya karena lebih dari satu citra per tandan dipakai. Abstrak dan kesimpulan menyebut akurasi rerata 79,48%, sedangkan Tabel 4 (h. 8) menyebut 79,17%.

c1.hasil_ringkas: YOLO11-PMSL menaikkan presisi 3,3 dan mAP0,5 9,3 poin persentase; ByteTrack-DIoU menaikkan MOTA 5,5, 5,7, dan 4,3 poin persentase terhadap SORT, DeepSORT, dan BoT-SORT; akurasi rerata hitung berbasis pelacakan 88,4%.

bukti: [parafrasa web] Proposes a citrus fruit tracking and counting method for UAV video streams that fuses a lightweight YOLO11-PMSL detector with a ByteTrack-DIoU algorithm.
[parafrasa web] A region-counting anti-jitter mechanism is embedded in ByteTrack-DIoU to resolve ID switches caused by occlusion.
[parafrasa web] Multi-object tracking accuracy rises 5.5, 5.7 and 4.3 points over SORT, DeepSORT and BoT-SORT; average tracking-count accuracy reaches 88.4%.
catatan: Abstrak (terjemahan dari bahasa Tionghoa) tidak menyebut acuan hitung; kode anotasi adalah dugaan (hitung manual pada video), karena pemeriksa tidak menerima nilai kosong. Naskah lengkap berbahasa Tionghoa dengan abstrak Inggris di jurnal; bila protokol menilai bahasa naskah, E7 perlu dipertimbangkan.

bukti: a multiple–object-tracking method was combined with known information about tree spacing to estimate the position of each trunk across video sequences
On the test dataset, all trunks are successfully detected. For the subset of images where ground truth data was available, the root mean square error (RMSE) for trunk position was 15.6 pixels.
catatan: Detektor mengenali buah dan batang, tetapi yang dilacak dan dievaluasi hanya posisi batang (RMSE 15,6 piksel); hitung buah tidak dievaluasi. Kasus batas: kajian ini komponen sistem hitung apel berbasis video (pembagian buah per pohon), sehingga peninjau lain dapat mengodekannya C1 (M3). Abstrak tidak melaporkan hasil hitung buah.

bukti: the aim is to propose an outdoor image-based fresh fruit bunch (FFB) classification system, emphasising pre-processing technique and feature extraction techniques suitable for limited datasets
the FFB was localised within the original images using the YOLOv4-Tiny algorithm

predict five classes: damaged, empty, unripe, ripe, and overripe. The developed system demonstrated a commendable performance in accurately classifying fruit bunches, achieving an accuracy of 93.68 %.
catatan: Abstrak hanya menyebut citra luar ruang; tidak jelas apakah tandan di pohon, di tanah, atau di tempat pengumpulan, sehingga lokasi diberi tanda tanya. Kelas rusak dan kosong mengisyaratkan tandan sudah dipanen. YOLOv4-Tiny dipakai hanya untuk melokalkan tandan sebelum klasifikasi, sehingga tugas utama KLS.

bukti: [parafrasa web] This paper aims to propose a suitable color model for oil palm fruit ripeness identification; two color models are experimented, RGB and HSV.
[parafrasa web] HSV color model proved to be the best color model for oil palm ripeness identification, in line with the MPOB color definition.
catatan: Abstrak OpenAlex tidak menyebut lokasi pengambilan citra, jumlah citra, maupun angka akurasi; konteksnya penilaian di pabrik, tetapi lokasi tidak dinyatakan. Tidak jelas apakah objek citra berupa tandan utuh atau buah lepas.

bukti: [parafrasa web] This paper proposed an improved YOLO model to detect oil palm loose fruits from unmanned aerial vehicle images.
[parafrasa web] The proposed model achieves average precision of 99.76% with detection time of 34.06 ms.
